AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION

Council Chambers  Tuesday

340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to
request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning
Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of
Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council
Chamber.

We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign
contributions within the last twelve months.

The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after
the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City
Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerk’s office
(R05-14).

The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date
following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever
occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2)
Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend,
modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the
circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development
entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and
final.

The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and
advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

 COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning
Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Items under this heading are suggested by Staff as appropriate for the Consent Agenda. Additional
items may be handled on the Consent Calendar, as determined by the Planning Commission. There
will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Planning Commissioner or member of the
audience so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the General Order of Business
and considered following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. Items approved on the
Consent Calendar are approved in one motion and incorporate the findings contained in the Staff

ACTION MEMO
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  SEPTEMBER 15, 2015

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  September 15, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Present: Thomas, Hunter, Welch & Kao
  Absent: Evans

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT ITEMS – #1, 2 & 4

1.  NC-1537-15; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions
  & remodeling to the single family residence located at 3900 Via Palomino. Lot 2, Block
  6231, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey A. Dahl
  18681 Amalia Lane
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  John Rogers

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Hunter seconded to approve the
application (4-0, Evans absent) with standard conditions.

Planning Commission  1  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
September 15, 2015
 2.  NC-1538/M-1059-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Miscellaneous
  Applications for additions & remodeling to the single family residence located at 1409
  Via Zumaya. Lot 71, Tract 27438. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Brett Buchmann
  1632 Aviation Blvd.
  Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner:  Ken Shinoda

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Hunter seconded to approve the
application (4-0, Evans absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) A standard urban stormwater mitigation plan, approved by the City
Engineer shall be prepared and implemented for the project; and 2) This project is
considered Hillside Residential and shall comply with Municipal NPDES Permit.

ITEM OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF

3.  Study Session Report of the Energy Efficiency Climate Action Plan (EECAP) –

Received & filed. Sarah Favrot from Atkins, consultant to South Bay Cities Council of
Governments, provided a brief presentation regarding the EECAP project background,
community energy reduction measures, municipal energy reduction measures, and the next
step in the EECAP process. The reduction measures will be forwarded to the City Council
for consideration and adoption.

PUBLIC HEARING

4.  CUP-88-15; Consideration of a Conditional Use Permit Application for a new Jr.
  Clubhouse at the Palos Verdes Tennis Club located at 3303 Via Campesina. Portion of
  Lot B, Tract 4400. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Class 2, Section 15302.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey A. Dahl
  18681 Amalia Lane
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  Palos Verdes Tennis Club

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Hunter seconded to approve the
application (4-0, Evans absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) A transition plan and/or phasing plan shall be submitted to the City
identifying a proposed timeline for compliance with ADA regulations and standards; and
2) Signage and required parking shall be provided in accordance with the California
Building Code.

Planning Commission  2  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
September 15, 2015
 OLD BUSINESS

5.  NC-1470R/M-1039-15; Consideration of Revised Neighborhood Compatibility &
  Miscellaneous Applications for the new single family residence located at 1120 Granvia
  Altamira. Lot 14, Block 1750, Tract 8652. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Greg George
  318 Avenue I, #154
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Ali & Karen Sarmast

Action: Commissioner Thomas moved and Commissioner Hunter seconded to approve, in
part, (4-0, Evans absent) the reconfiguration of the existing pool, new spa, relocated pool
equipment, revisions to the driveway, new landing and stairs, new bbq, new fireplace, and
revisions to hardscape with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1)
Landscaping within the City right-of-way shall be maintained at a maximum height of 30
inches. New street trees within the City right-of-way shall be subject to the review and
approval of the City Forrester; and 2) A drainage easements shall be obtained if drainage
is conveyed through adjacent private property to Novato Place. The proposal for the
covered patio was continued.

NEW BUSINESS

6.  Request to appeal the Director’s approval of a Minor Modification Application for NC-
  1447/GA-1496/M-875-12; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 1901 Paseo Del Sol. Lot 4,
  Block 1542, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Appellant:  Thomas Chan
  1905 Paseo Del Sol
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner:  Dr. & Mrs. Vinod Jivrajka
  1549 Via Lopez
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to confirm the
Director’s decision to approve (4-0, Evans absent) the Minor Modification application with
the following condition: The second story east facing closet window be fixed and
translucent.

Planning Commission  3  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
September 15, 2015
 7.  NC-1528/G-1551/M-1057-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 521 & 525 Via
  Almar. Lots 6 & 7, Block 1512, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Jeffrey A. Dahl
  18681 Amalia Lane
  Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner:  Steven & Helen Lundblad

Action: Commissioner Hunter moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to approve the
application (3-1, Kao dissenting & Evans absent) with standard conditions and the
following additional conditions: 1) A licensed survey of the total floor area shall be
completed and submitted to the City to verify compliance with the approved floor area for
the subject lot; 2) The street tree within the City right-of-way shall be replaced, subject to
the review and approval of the City Forrester, or payment to the City tree bank shall be
required; 3) Prior to issuance of building permits, the property owners shall: (a) Execute a
Covenant and Agreement to Hold Property as One Parcel, and (b) File for a “lot tie” with the
Los Angeles County Assessor’s Office; and 3) Drainage to Via Media shall be within a
dedicated drainage easement.

8.  NC-874RIII/G-1554/SC-135/M-1058-15; Consideration of revised Neighborhood
  Compatibility, Grading, Sports Court & Miscellaneous Applications for additions to the
  single family residence & new sports court located at 1821 Paseo Del Sol. Lot 8, Block
  1541, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Art Ashai, Architect
  655 Deep Valley Dr. #220
  Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274
  Owner:  Amar & Rita Shokeen

Action: Commissioner Hunter moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve the
application (4-0, Evans absnet) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) Maintenance of the landscape vegetation surrounding the sports court shall
not be lower than the height of the court fence and no higher than three feet above the
height of the court fence; 2) A standard urban stormwater mitigation plan, approved by
the City Engineer shall be prepared and implemented for the project; and 3) This project is
considered Hillside Residential and shall comply with Municipal NPDES Permit.

Planning Commission  4  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
September 15, 2015
 9.  NC-1535/G-1555/M-1055-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading &
  Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 2404 Via
  Ramon. Lot 10, Block 1714, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Douglas Leach
  119 W. Torrance Blvd., #24
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Richard & Marcie May
  2516 Via Tejon
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Commissioner Welch moved and Commissioner Kao seconded to approve the
application on (4-0, Evans absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) A licensed survey of the lot coverage shall be completed and submitted to the
City to verify compliance with the approved lot coverage for the subject lot; 2) A standard
urban stormwater mitigation plan, approved by the City Engineer shall be prepared and
implemented for the project; 3) This project is considered Hillside Residential and shall
comply with Municipal NPDES Permit; and 4) Tributary offsite flows shall be collected
and conveyed to the street via approved drainage devices.

10.  NC-1536/G-1556-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 617 Via Estrada. Lot 15, Block
  2223, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Douglas Leach
  119 W. Torrance Blvd. #24
  Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner:  Ryan & Kristin Kresser

Action: Commissioner Kao moved and Commissioner Welch seconded to approve the
application (4-0, Evans absent) with standard conditions and the following additional
conditions: 1) A licensed survey of the floor area and lot coverage shall be completed and
submitted to the City to verify compliance with the approved floor area and lot coverage
for the subject lot; 2) Curb and gutter along the property frontage on Via Estrada shall be
installed. Engineering and design shall be in accordance with City standards; and 3) All
non-standard encroachments shall be removed.

Planning Commission  5  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
September 15, 2015
 11.  NC-1540/G-1558/M-1051-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading,
  & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 908 Via
  Rincon. Lot 9, Block 1630, Tract 7142. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  George Sweeney
  3 Malaga Cove Plaza #201
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner:  Richard & Cecilia Hu

Continued to the October 20, 2015 Planning Commission meeting.

12.  PR-149-15; Consideration of a Preliminary Review Application for a potential wireless
  telecommunication facility within the City right-of-way located at 2702 Palos Verdes
  Drive North.

  Applicant:  CES for AT&T Mobility
  10640 Sepulveda Boulevard, Ste. 1
  Mission Hills, CA 91345

Preliminary Review given. The Planning Commission directed the applicant to work with
the neighbors to address their concerns with the wireless telecommunication facility
equipment. If the neighbors’ concerns are not addressed, the formal application should be
forwarded to the Planning Commission for review.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMISSION/STAFF

14.  Minor Revisions - Received & filed.

15.  Schedule of Upcoming Art Jury Meetings - Received & filed.

PM.

This Planning Commission meeting can be viewed on Cox Cable, Channel 35, Saturday,
